# truenas_nvmet_port (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS NVMe-oF transport port by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric NVMe-oF port ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `addr_adrfam` (String) Address family (e.g. IPV4) derived from addr_traddr.
- `addr_traddr` (String) Transport address (IP address) the port listens on.
- `addr_trsvcid` (Number) Transport service ID (TCP/RDMA port number).
- `addr_trtype` (String) TCP or RDMA.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the port is enabled.
- `index` (Number) Numeric index assigned by TrueNAS for this port.
- `inline_data_size` (Number) Inline data size (bytes) for this port.
- `max_queue_size` (Number) Maximum queue size for this port.
- `pi_enable` (Boolean) Whether end-to-end data protection (PI) is enabled for this port.
